subcategories.Dev Tools: AI tools developers use for their own coding work (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, prompting techniques for writing code).
subcategories.Agent Building: Building AI agents, MCP servers, or generative-AI features/extensions that a partner delivers for a customer.
subcategories.Business Use: Using AI/Copilot features inside Business Central itself, or AI from a functional/consultant/sales perspective (not building or coding with AI).

BI.description: Business intelligence and reporting on Business Central data, e.g. Power BI, MS Fabric, Excel reporting.
